# Security and Access Control Checklist: Portal de Transparência da CPA

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade, a clareza, a consistência e a cobertura dos requisitos de autenticação, controle de acesso e permissões por perfil.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Autenticação e Sessão

- [x] CHK001 Are the credential requirements for login (e-mail, senha e critérios mínimos de força) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior for invalid credentials specified, incluindo mensagem, limite de tentativas e bloqueio? [Completeness, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK003 Are the requirements defined for usuários inativos, incluindo se o motivo da recusa é revelado? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Is the 168-hour session expiry objective and is the renewal rule on a new login specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for simultaneous sessions on multiple devices ou navegadores? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Are the password recovery requirements complete, incluindo quem autoriza e qual prova de identidade é exigida? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Controle de Acesso e Perfis

- [x] CHK007 Are the six profiles and their exact permissions per resource documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 Is the behavior for a user with multiple profiles specified, deixando explícito se as permissões são unidas ou interseccionadas? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for blocking direct access to unauthorized pages, não apenas ocultá-las da navegação? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is "base de dados bruta" defined precisely, incluindo o que abrange e como é acessada? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is the conflict between FR-006 (Diretor e Administrativo) e RNF04 (exclui Diretor) resolvido nos requisitos? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Are the Coordenador permissions restricted to the own course specified de forma verificável? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Conteúdo e Permissões

- [x] CHK013 Is the mapping between dashboards and profiles defined as data, incluindo a ordenação de exibição? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for when a dashboard embed is unavailable ou falha ao carregar? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Is the "publicada" status for devolutivas and its visibility rules specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 Are document visibility by profile and the behavior for removed or replaced documents specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK017 Are the official contact channels and their authoritative source specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Cobertura de Fluxos e Casos de Borda

- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for unauthenticated access to restricted pages, incluindo a mensagem exibida? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK019 Are empty-state requirements defined for dashboards, devolutivas, relatórios and contato? [Gap]
- [x] CHK020 Is the behavior specified when the session expires during navigation, incluindo a preservação do destino original? [Edge Case, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for users with more than one profile ao navegar entre páginas e recursos? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are the administration flow requirements complete for criar/gerenciar usuários, cursos e publicar conteúdo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]

## Requisitos Não Funcionais

- [x] CHK023 Are password storage and secret management requirements documented, sem depender de detalhes de implementação? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Is the audit requirement specified em detalhe: quais eventos, quais campos e por quanto tempo reter? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK025 Are performance targets defined per critical journey and stated in a measurable way? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK026 Are accessibility requirements for the portal specified, incluindo navegação por teclado? [Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Are privacy and data protection requirements for personal data (CPF, data de nascimento) documented? [Gap]

## Dependências, Assunções e Rastreabilidade

- [x] CHK028 Are the external dashboard dependencies and their availability assumptions documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that public pages require no login validated and consistent with all pages described? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 Does every functional requirement have identifiable acceptance criteria that a reviewer can verify? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK031 Is there a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme for traceability across spec, plan and tasks? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
